criterion_order: Use the specified Internet Archive item (prideprejudice00aust)
Respect interaction constraints (no download/borrow/sign-in/add to collection) and stop after recording requested info
criterion_descriptions: Navigate to and use only the Internet Archive item 'prideprejudice00aust' (e.g., via https://archive.org/details/prideprejudice00aust) as the sole source. Full credit if the agent clearly bases findings on this item page. Partial credit if the agent appears to use the correct item but does not make that clear. Full credit if the item page is inaccessible due to an uncontrollable blocker (e.g., CAPTCHA/site error) and the agent clearly reports the issue without switching to other items/sources. No credit if metadata is taken from a different item/edition or an external source.

Extract and report the publication year shown on the item page (as displayed). Full credit for the exact year as displayed. Full credit if the year is not displayed and the agent explicitly reports it as missing/not shown. Full credit if the page/metadata cannot be accessed due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent reports that. Partial credit if the agent reports an approximate/ambiguous year or confuses publication year with another date field when the correct publication year is visible.

Extract and report the publisher shown on the item page (as displayed). Full credit for the exact publisher text as displayed. Full credit if publisher is not displayed and the agent explicitly reports it as not shown. Full credit if the page/metadata cannot be accessed due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent reports that. Partial credit if incomplete/truncated or if the agent confuses publisher with another field when the correct publisher is visible.

Extract and report the language shown on the item page (as displayed). Full credit for the exact language value as displayed. Full credit if language is not displayed and the agent explicitly reports it as not shown. Full credit if the page/metadata cannot be accessed due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent reports that. Partial credit for ambiguity or confusion with other metadata when the correct language is visible.

Identify and report every Topic displayed on the item page exactly as shown (not a subset). Full credit if all displayed Topics are captured. Full credit if no Topics are displayed and the agent explicitly states that none are shown. Full credit if Topics cannot be verified due to an uncontrollable blocker or page section failing to load and the agent reports that limitation. Partial credit if some Topics are missing/paraphrased when exact labels are visible.

Under 'Download Options' on the same item page, verify whether an EPUB download option is available (present vs not present). Full credit for correctly stating availability as shown in Download Options. Full credit if the Download Options list cannot be accessed/loaded due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent reports that. Partial credit if the agent reports availability without clearly tying it to 'Download Options' or appears to infer.

Under 'Download Options', verify whether 'FULL TEXT' is available (present vs not present). Full credit for correctly stating availability as shown in Download Options. Full credit if the Download Options list cannot be accessed/loaded due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent reports that. Partial credit for confusing other text formats (e.g., 'Text' or 'PDF with text') with 'FULL TEXT' when 'FULL TEXT' is explicitly listed.

Under 'Download Options', verify whether 'B/W PDF' is available (present vs not present). Full credit for correctly stating availability as shown in Download Options. Full credit if the Download Options list cannot be accessed/loaded due to an uncontrollable blocker and the agent reports that. Partial credit if the agent checks a different PDF derivative (e.g., 'PDF' or 'Color PDF') instead of the specifically named 'B/W PDF' when 'B/W PDF' is listed.

Comply with constraints: do not download files, do not borrow, do not sign in, and do not add the item to a collection; stop after recording the requested metadata, all displayed Topics, and availability of the three specified formats. Full credit if the agent avoids these actions and ends promptly after gathering required information (or after clearly documenting an uncontrollable blocker that prevents gathering it). Partial credit if the agent takes unnecessary extra steps but does not violate constraints. No credit if the agent downloads/borrows/signs in/adds to collection.
